po_number.description: PO number from the provided open_pos list the message is about; null if unclear.

reply_text.description: Short reply to the supplier (used when no further processing happens).

promised_delivery_date.description: Delivery date the supplier states (YYYY-MM-DD, resolved against today); null if none.

reason.description: For cancellation_request / revision_request: the supplier's stated reason, one short sentence; else null.
